task:
Several mapping types misbehave. Fix all of these.

OMD equality ignores trailing (None, None) items. OMD([(None, None)]) must not equal OMD([(None, None), (None, None)]), in either direction. QueryParamDict must behave the same way.

OMD.update with an iterable of pairs drops values when a key that is new to the mapping repeats in the iterable. After omd = OMD(); omd.update([('a', 1), ('a', 3)]), getlist('a') must be [1, 3]. Starting from [('a', 0), ('b', 0)], update([('a', 1), ('c', 2), ('a', 3), ('c', 4)]) must give getlist('a') == [1, 3], getlist('c') == [2, 4] and getlist('b') == [0]. QueryParamDict must behave the same way.

OneToOne.update must accept a one-shot iterator of pairs: update(iter([('a', 1), ('b', 2)])) on an empty mapping must give {'a': 1, 'b': 2} with inv {1: 'a', 2: 'b'}. An unhashable value anywhere in the input must raise TypeError and leave the mapping unchanged. OneToOne must support |= in place, keeping its identity: OneToOne({'a': 1}) |= {'c': 2, 'd': 1} gives {'c': 2, 'd': 1} with inv {1: 'd', 2: 'c'}.

ManyToMany.add('new', []) must raise TypeError and leave the key out, so the mapping stays empty. ManyToMany(other) must make an independent copy in both directions: adding to the copy must not change the original, and adding through the original's inv must not change the copy. replace(key, newkey) onto a key that already exists must merge: ManyToMany([('a', 1), ('new', 2)]).replace('a', 'new') leaves no 'a', gives m2m['new'] == frozenset([1, 2]), and both inv[1] and inv[2] equal frozenset(['new']).

Everything else must keep working.
accept: PYTHONPATH=.bench-deps python3 -m pytest -q -o addopts= -p no:cacheprovider tests
